description: This file contains Kotlin class definitions for custom Android UI components such as BannerView, LandscapeCardView, TopNavBarView, and NavPillView. These components are used for rendering banners, landscape cards, a top navigation bar with pills, and their visual behaviors within an Android application.

classes.name: BannerView
classes.description: A custom view that displays a banner image with rounded corners and a border that appears when focused.

classes.name: LandscapeCardView
classes.description: A custom view for rendering a landscape-oriented poster with overlay title and focus border, with rounded corners.

classes.name: TopNavBarView
classes.description: A horizontal pill-shaped navigation bar that supports bounded left/right DPAD navigation and default focus on 'Inicio'.

classes.name: NavPillView
classes.description: A pill-shaped button with rounded background, optional search icon, and visual state changes on focus.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Method in BannerView that binds a BannerItem (not defined here) to the view, setting the image and accessibility content description.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Method in LandscapeCardView that binds a LandscapeItem (not defined here), setting image and title overlay.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Configures the TopNavBarView with a list of navigation items and sets default selection and focus.

methods.name: setSelectedIndex
methods.description: Updates the selected navigation pill and notifies listener.

methods.name: handleKey
methods.description: Handles DPAD left/right key events to move focus across navigation pills.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the label text in NavPillView.

methods.name: setIsSearch
methods.description: Configures NavPillView to display as a search pill with icon.

methods.name: setSelectedVisual
methods.description: Changes the visual state of NavPillView to indicate selection.
